note: Names and descriptions are the official list as PlayStation publishes it. Every guide is written in my own words for this entry and cites its sources; no guide text is copied from any source.

trophies.guide: This is the reward for earning the other 54 trophies, so there is no trick to it beyond finishing the whole list. Work through the four roadmap stages in this guide and it pops the moment the last trophy lands. Expect roughly 200 hours for the full run.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Open the 100% checklist under Progress, Stats, 100% Completion after the story ends and clear every line on it: story, activities, collectibles and challenges (70 of the 80 challenges, 300 stunts, 200 of the 277 vehicle models, all 39 illegal operations, 8 bank vaults). Work you did before the credits still counts, so chip away at it during the whole playthrough instead of leaving it all for the end.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Play the story to its end and finish the last mission. Keep a manual save from just before it, since the game has no mission replay and that save is your safety net for anything you still want to redo.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Stunt jumps, flights under bridges, knife-edge flights and base jumps all feed the counter. Keep a fast bike and a stunt plane handy and tick off jumps whenever you pass one rather than saving all 250 for the endgame; the 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past this trophy.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Visit both shooting ranges and gold every challenge between them (42 gold medals in total). Learn each range's target pattern, use the weapon the challenge hands you, and replay the ones you miss until the gold lands; there is no time pressure, so take them one at a time.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.guide: Bank vaults open through the optional mission That's Where The Money Is, near the end of Chapter 4: tail an armored security van to a large bank and slip into the vault while the guard has it open. Bring your partner, because one person cannot carry all the bags, and expect a 4-star wanted level the moment you leave — escaping it with your partner also earns Hot Together. Five vaults, eight for the 100% checklist.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish eight stranger mission strands across Leonida. Only some questlines count toward the eight — Andy's, Billy's and Tyrone's have their own trophies and do not count — so check the trophy's progress counter after each strand you finish and move on to the next stranger marker if the number did not move.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.guide: Collectible cards are scattered around Leonida; a finished set means every card in that set. Work one set at a time, use the in-game collection screen to see which cards you still lack, and sweep each region fully before moving on so you are not backtracking across the whole map.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Open the WAiNK app at 100 different spots around the state. Make it a habit: whenever you arrive somewhere new, open the app and check in before you drive off. It pairs naturally with exploring the map for The Goodtime State.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It is the first story mission, so this pops early in your playthrough with no special preparation.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1. Before you leave the chapter, do Lucia's balcony meditation — it is the one thing in the whole game that can be missed, and it counts toward Positive Mental Attitude.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 2. Character switching between Jason and Lucia opens after Breakfast Run in this chapter, which also unlocks the partner trophies, so start calling your partner in for jobs from here on.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 3. This is where the robbery tools arrive: the Snap Gun from Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs for Sneakthief, and Yago's time-sensitive street race — save before that race, because its hourglass timer does not wait.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 4. Bank vaults open near the end of this chapter through That's Where The Money Is, so do that optional mission before the finale if you want Maximum Withdrawal out of the way early.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Finish the mission Breakfast Run in Chapter 2. It also opens character switching between Jason and Lucia, so after it you can call your partner in for the duo trophies.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission The Cartel Heist. No extra preparation is needed; it pops when the mission ends.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Child's Play. It pops on mission completion, so just play the story through.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Headliners. Like the other mission trophies, it is unmissable as long as you play the story.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission VCIA Takedown at Vice City International Airport. The same airport is where Catch Me If You Can happens in free roam, so remember the layout for later.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Operation Savage Glory. It pops when the mission wraps up.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Play Andy's stranger strand to its last mission and finish it. Andy's strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks, so treat it as its own storyline and follow the strand markers until the finale.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Play Kenton's strand to its final mission and complete it. Follow the strand markers whenever they appear and finish the last job to pop the trophy.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Play Billy's strand to its final mission and complete it. Like Andy's, Billy's strand has its own trophy and does not feed Strangers & Freaks, so finish the whole strand on its own terms.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Play Randy's strand to its final mission and complete it. Keep following Randy's markers until the last mission ends.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Play Tyrone's strand to its final mission and complete it. Tyrone's strand also has its own trophy, so it does not count toward Strangers & Freaks.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Follow Bret Vogel's hunting questline — Jason-only — and take down the unique animal his target decks point you to. A clean head or heart shot keeps the carcass pristine, which is what a hunter's trophy is about. Check Bret's markers after each hunt for the next target.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Play one round of every activity type on the map: races, shooting range, fishing, arcade games, drone races, bowling and the rest. Open the map, pick an activity icon you have not tried yet, and do a single round — the trophy counts types, not wins.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.guide: Win twenty races that are all different — the same race twice only counts once. Work through the race types across Leonida (street, off-road, boat, air) and keep a fast, well-handled vehicle for each surface. The Top Fun drone races are a separate trophy, so do not confuse the two counters.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level and then lose the police completely — not just the flashing search area, but the red heat zone itself. Bank vault jobs hand you 4 stars on a plate, so escape one with your partner and this pops with Maximum Withdrawal.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Call your partner, then rob three shops in a row while the police are still chasing you. If the stars fade and you are only in the red heat zone, the chain breaks — so keep moving and hit the next shop fast. It can take about 30 seconds to pop after you leave the third shop, so give it a moment before hitting a fourth.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Scan vehicles with the WAiNK app to log them as discovered. Scan traffic as you drive and every new model counts; the 100% checklist wants 200 of the 277 base models, so keep scanning long after this trophy pops.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.guide: Reveal every region of the map by driving, flying and walking through it all. Work region by region and watch the map fill in; pairing this with WAiNK check-ins and vehicle scanning means one road trip feeds three trophies at once.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation from each of the nine gangs. The 100% checklist wants all 39 operations, so this pops naturally along the way — just make sure the gang tally, not the raw count, is what you watch.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Marked bills come from bank and payday loan jobs; sell them to your contacts to launder them. The $250,000 total is cumulative, so keep laundering every marked bill you earn instead of letting them pile up.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win at least one Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations. Learn each course's line before you race it for real, and remember these are drone races — they do not count toward the 20 different races of Earn Cash, Not Kudos.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in total across every kind of shop — clothes, weapons, food, anything. The total is cumulative, so normal shopping across the whole playthrough gets you most of the way there; top it up with a big purchase at the end if you are short.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy all eight garages in the Vice City Real Estate app, which unlocks after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver. Together they cost about $160,000, and garages the story gives you do not count — only the ones you buy.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: The Chapter 2 mission Moses opens the Scooter Bros app. Take a stolen car to Moses, choose Respray, then Register; from Chapter 3 you can also register cars with a standard tracker at Pay 'n' Spray. Each car needs a free garage space, so buy garages first and register cheap cars.
trophies.name: On the Spot

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Find Cal and take his fishing challenge, then out-fish him. Keep your line steady, reel in when the fish bites, and do not rush the fight — a patient catch beats a fast one.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Play any of the four in-game arcade games through to completion. Pick the one you enjoy most; any finished game counts.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: THE ONLY MISSABLE TROPHY. Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida. Meditation spots show as purple icons when you are close, and each outdoor spot should count twice if you meditate there with both characters, so bring your partner every time. Do Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1 — after she is home, check the kitchen in the morning (a morning after the mission Down to Earth is the usual time), follow her out to the balcony of Jason's house and accept the optional task. It is gone once Chapter 1 ends, and there is no mission replay. Keep a manual save at the start of every chapter.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Combat Focus is the slow-motion aim — press L3 and R3 while aiming. Pick a group of gang enemies, such as the guards at an illegal operation, take an assault rifle, and drop five of them before Focus runs out. Adrenaline extends Focus, so use it when the group is bunched together.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: The Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs gives you the Snap Gun and opens jewelry store robberies. Go to a store's locked back door and use the Snap Gun on it — kicking the door in sets off the alarm. Inside the back room, find the note with the safe code, open the safe, and leave without being seen. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good target; if someone spots you, reload and try again.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Hit an armored truck and get away clean — the trophy only pops once you have left the red heat zone, so keep driving until the wanted level is fully gone, not just out of the flashing search area.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Challenges are listed under Progress, Challenges. Fifty of them, and many complete on their own while you play; the 100% checklist needs 70 of the 80, so treat this trophy as a milestone on the way to A Long Road rather than a separate grind.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: At Vice City International Airport, steal a large passenger plane that is docked at a boarding bridge — planes parked elsewhere on the airfield do not count. The planes at gates E3 and E4 work. Get to the cockpit, back out toward the runway and take off. The trophy is delayed: fly about 1 km away from the airport and it pops. Save first, because the police come fast.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Get into a military tank. Tanks should be parked on the south side of Mile Zero Air Station, on the island at the far southwest of the map. Save first, get in, and drive and fire until it pops.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: The Kolt & Associates bowling alley is Kingpin Bowling, an illegal operation you visit in Chapter 2. Bring Sticky Bombs and take all three key valuables: the luxury watch in an office, the shotgun on a table, and the contents of the office safe, which you blow open with a Sticky Bomb. Then escape the police. If you leave something behind, the operation comes back later, so it is not missable.
trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling

trophies.guide: This one is about Jason and Lucia training together: buy a gym membership and train with your partner there, since the partner trains alongside you. Get both of them to maximum Strength and the trophy should pop.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile. Robberies and fights feed it, so it fills up on its own over a normal playthrough — keep playing the way the game wants you to and check the counter now and then rather than grinding it in one sitting.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Head to a bar on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail, and enjoy it with the view. A quiet moment between jobs — just sit, sip, and let the trophy pop.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Drive a car straight through a vehicle showroom's glass front and out the other side. Pick a showroom with a clear run-up, build speed, and smash through — the classic way out.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.guide: This one pops when a second attempt succeeds where the first failed — a retry that lands. Keep playing and it will come to you; it is tied to an in-game moment of trying again, not to a grind.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: A trophy for a strange, surprising moment in Leonida — the kind of thing that happens once and makes you stop and stare. Keep exploring the odd corners of the map and it will find you.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock enemies over with a melee weapon while driving past them. Find a slow stretch of road with pedestrians or enemies nearby, line up the pass, and swing as you go by — one clean hit is all it takes.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
